title: Wings live: KB Hallen, Copenhagen | 1972
content:
Wings performed at the KB Hallen in Copenhagen, Denmark, on 1 August 1972.

It was the ninth night of the Wings Over Europe Tour, which opened in Ollioules, France, on 9 July. They were Paul McCartney’s first European concerts since 1966.

Wings did not perform their usual encore, ‘Long Tall Sally’. Instead they played a reprise of ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’.

The Beatles had performed at the KB Hallen on 4 June 1964.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.
